# Motion acceptance fixture pages (Spec 38A M2.9)

Block trees for `scripts/wp-build-page.js`, probed by `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-model.mjs`. The probe finds each page by its `.m29-*` marker classes, so any page ID built from these trees works. Build with `--create page` (never over the motion-QA fixture pages), then record the new IDs in `.claude/rules/motion-qa.md`.

- `hover-entrance.json`: a first-section heading with a page-load entrance (`.m29-load-first`, LCP rule), a later page-load entrance that fades (`.m29-load-later`), an info-box card with a hover lift, scale, token duration and colour hover (`.m29-hover-card`) beside a plain control card (`.m29-plain-card`), and a container whose inner part has a below-the-fold Fade up on a distance token with a stored 200 ms entrance delay (`.m29-fade-part`; the card also stores a 100 ms hover delay, so the reduced-motion delay check reads non-zero under no-preference) beside an unanimated sibling (`.m29-fade-sibling`).
- `keyframes-tilt.json`: a below-the-fold three-keyframe entrance with a stored 500 ms delay (`.m29-kf`) beside a sibling with none, a heading with both a scroll entrance and a hover lift (`.m29-both`), and an info-box with the legacy 3D tilt (`.m29-tilt`, class `sgs-has-tilt-3d` from `sgsHoverTilt3D`).
- `no-motion.json`: a heading and text with no motion at all (`.m29-nomotion`), for the check that no motion stylesheet or script loads.
- `motion-per-device.json` (M3.9, canary page 5244): an entrance with Desktop 24px, Tablet 16px and Mobile 8px translate distances and a copy with Mobile cleared, hovers with a custom `cubic-bezier()` and a `linear()` easing, an `sgs/team-member` whose photo part alone moves on a whole-block hover, three tilted cards each at its own rest angle that straighten on hover, and a polaroid frame (markers `.m39-*`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-per-device.mjs` (FR-38A-4, 12, 13, 42).
- `scroll-progress.json`: a fixed-at-top page bar (`.m58-bar`, source page, bar-x), a counter (`.m58-counter`, source page, percent) in the first section, and a bar inside a mid-page section (`.m58-section-bar`, source section) with tall spacer sections before and after it, so the section bar rests at 0 before it enters and 1 after it leaves. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-scroll-progress.mjs` (FR-38A-36).
- `ripple.json` (M5.9): three buttons in one container: a pointerdown ripple with the Indus values (`.m59-down`: size factor 2.2, white, peak opacity 0.35, 650ms, linear), a click-trigger copy (`.m59-click`) and a button with no ripple (`.m59-control`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-ripple.mjs` (FR-38A-45).
- `magnet.json` (M5.4): three buttons, each in its own padded container: an over-element normalised magnet with spans 10px and 8px and a 250ms `cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.32,1)` return (`.m54-over`), a proximity magnet with a 120px radius (`.m54-prox`) and a button with no magnet (`.m54-control`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-magnet.mjs` (FR-38A-40); the nav-bar label check needs a page carrying an `sgs/nav-bar-menu` with the label magnet on (`--nav-page`).
- `cursor-field.json` (M5.11): two cards with the `image-reveal` cursor field with the reference-draft values (rest radius 0 to hover 90px over 400ms, wash 0.5 to 0.3): `.m511-reveal` adds the 180px ring (3px white border, shadow, 400ms lag) and a pointerdown ripple, `.m511-plain` is the field alone. Set the `image` value (a media ID) on both layers after building; the wash and ring measure without it. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-cursor-field.mjs --reveal --page <id>` (FR-38A-34).
- `horizontal-panel.json` (M5.5): a spacer, an `sgs/timeline` horizontal with five entries pinned by the horizontal-panel effect (`.m55-hp`: pin length 70vh per panel plus a 40vh tail, no smoothing, linear, proximity focus on with the 0.94 and 0.55 edge values, progress output and active state on), and a spacer after (`.m55-before`, `.m55-after`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-horizontal-panel-params.mjs` (FR-38A-38, FR-38A-39, FR-38A-50).
- `motion-stacks.json` (M5.Z): the stacked effects on generic fixture cards: a button with magnet, sheen and ripple (`.m5z-a`), a card with Follow pointer at 8deg, hover scale 1.04 and a -6px lift (`.m5z-b`), a card with the lift, a page-basis parallax and Follow pointer (`.m5z-c`), a card with the cursor-field image-reveal ring, ripple and sheen (`.m5z-d`), a no-motion control card (`.m5z-control`) and a scroll spacer. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-stacks.mjs` (FR-38A-23, 47, 49, 50 and the page-weight budget).
